pm_approval.source: Current chat, reply to the three-PM preview

merchant_scope: User explicitly requested three tiers of distinct merchant components, a merchant-specific utility and a distinct ship icon.

entries.prompt: A SINGLE compact square Victoria 3 production-method UI glyph: simple unfinished wooden boat hull on two carpenter trestles with one small adze across the bottom. Strict monochrome muted ochre beige, ALL parts same colour family. Match the native old-paper glyphs in the reference: coarse matte parchment texture, flatter cut-paper relief, lighter at top darker at bottom, very restrained bevel. Transparent background. NO glow, NO aura, NO external shadow cloud, NO drop shadow outside the silhouette, NO lighting background, NO metallic shine, NO lettering, NO border, NO realistic illustration. Sharp clean alpha silhouette with transparent empty padding on all four sides. One icon only, square canvas, object fills 75 percent width. The icon will display at 52px.

A SINGLE compact square Victoria 3 production-method UI glyph: side-view cutaway boat hull with two rows of overlapping rectangular sheathing plates on its lower half and two small plates beside it. ALL pieces uniformly monochrome muted lilac-purple, same purple as lower-right native glyph in reference. Match flat coarse matte aged-paper texture, top lighter and bottom darker, understated paper-cut relief. This is a native strategy-game symbol, NOT a 3D object rendering. Transparent blank background. NO GLOW, NO AURA, NO shadow cloud, NO exterior illumination or fog, NO metallic shine, NO gold, NO orange, NO red, NO lettering, NO border. Sharp clean alpha silhouette, plenty of completely transparent padding on all four sides. One icon only, square canvas, readable at 52px.

A single simple broadside silhouette icon of an eighteenth-century armed merchant brig: broad cargo hull, two square-rigged masts and a small fore-and-aft stern sail, just two tiny gun openings, visually distinct from a small lateen-rigged caravel. Native Victoria 3 ship-type pictogram, muted warm yellow-ochre monochrome, flat silhouette, top very subtly lighter bottom darker, minimal details, sails and hull clearly separated by transparent gaps. Transparent empty background, NO water scene, NO circles, NO frame, NO text, NO glow or aura, NO shadow outside the silhouette. Wide ship centered on square transparent canvas, all parts inside margins, readable at 64px.

Precisely edit this single purple paper game icon. Keep the exact boat hull and two loose plates, their positions, texture, monochrome lilac-purple colour, and transparent background. Add a broad circular prohibition ring and diagonal bar IN FRONT of the hull, entirely in the SAME muted lilac-purple family with the SAME aged paper grain and upper-light/lower-dark shading. No red or other colour anywhere. Ring must read clearly at 52px without obscuring the entire hull. Keep generous fully transparent padding around the whole icon. No glow, no aura, no exterior shadow cloud, no text. One square transparent UI glyph.

Create ONE separate compact square naval ship-component UI icon for Victoria 3. The reference shows the native bronze/silver/gold tier vocabulary. Match its aged matte paper-grain relief, clean chunky shapes, subtle bevel, light upper edges and dark lower edges. Use ONE colour family on ALL parts of the icon, no multicolour materials and no realistic illustration. Absolutely transparent empty background with clean cutout alpha. No glow, no aura, no exterior shadow cloud, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no frame. Entire object within all margins, readable at 40px. Tier: muted warm bronze-brown, simple basic. Subject: a broad merchant-ship hull cutaway with cargo space, 2 visible internal supporting ribs and 1 discreet reinforcing planks; emphasize a cargo boat, no sails and no shield.
entries.correction_prompt: Remove the entire raised deckhouse and vertical chimney; replace with a low upper gunwale. Preserve cutaway cargo crates, ribs, shape, bronze monochrome aged-paper texture, shading and transparency. No steamship, funnel, bridge cabin, glow or text.
